verdict.label: Steady market
verdict.headline: Card prices are steady: no strong move either way right now.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 71.0 (-1.7% in a day) and momentum is 51: prices are steady. 84s cost 1,000, 85s 3,000 and 86s 6,100. The weekend is ending, and prices usually ease into Monday.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-23T05:27:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Otávio 80 after its 47% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 54,500 coins. Now 72,500. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 47.3% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 7 of 13 so far, averaging +7.5% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Sell Quaresma 85 Base Hero after its 57% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 159,000 coins. Now 126,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 57.4% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 6 of 12 so far, averaging +5.6% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Weekend is ending: wait before buying
moves.detail: Prices usually ease as the weekend ends and players sell their squads. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-11-26T07:59:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 1,000 (1.20 coins per Item Score point), 85s 3,000 (1.43 coins per Item Score point), 86s 6,100 (1.49 coins per Item Score point), 87s 7,900 (1.44 coins per Item Score point), 88s 13,250 (1.60 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Célina Ould Hocine and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Célina Ould Hocine 76 Rare -69.7%; Deyna Castellanos 78 Rare -54.0%; Louisa Necib 87 Base Hero -43.1%; Désiré Doué 87 Star Performer -26.1%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
